summary: Verified iteration_27 Ultimate Gooner UI surfacing on Leaderboard, Profile page, and Lobby 'Show Tiers' modal. Backend regression: 32/32 tests green (test_ultimate_gooner + test_ranked_perf_rp + test_hotel_map + test_sniper_rework + test_royal_guard_shoot_through + test_jump_broadcast). Live E2E: bumped admin@shooter.com rank_points 0->2600 (triggers Goonmaster + top-50 cache). /api/auth/me returned rank_tier=7, leaderboard_rank=5. (a) /leaderboard live table renders 50 'ULTIMATE GOONER' gold pills + flame badges (confirmed via count=50). (b) /profile Current Rank card shows big 'ULTIMATE GOONER' text + flame badge with number '5' + '#5 GLOBAL' subtitle. Peak Rank card correctly still shows plain GOONMASTER (historical, not global). (c) Lobby 'SHOW TIERS' modal opens, tier-row-ultimate present, RP footer contains '(KILLS x 3) - (DEATHS x 5)' performance line and '+35 max win' cap. Regression: logged in as player1@shooter.com (rank_tier=0, leaderboard_rank=None) — 0 'ULTIMATE GOONER' text occurrences and 0 ultimate-badge elements on their profile. Admin restored to rp=0.

server.py TOP50_GOONER_IDS cache refresh loop (30s) is well-scoped; on-startup immediate refresh ensures freshness after restarts.
